intro.fallback: Although he figures out who Pain is, Jiraiya can neither speak nor move.

His life begins to fade and he reflects on the many failures of his life; his inability to protect the Third Hokage or Fourth Hokage; his inability to save Orochimaru; his inability to win the heart of Tsunade; and...
He then remembers how Naruto was named after the protagonist of his first book, making him Naruto's godfather.

outro.fallback: Since Naruto's nindō is to never give up, Jiraiya, as Naruto's teacher, decides that that should be his nindō too.
He finds the energy to relay a message to Fukasaku, confident that Naruto will save the world.
